names: Citric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
display_name: E472c (Citric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids)

more_info.overview: Citric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include milk-based drinks and similar products intended for young children, fats and oils essentially free from water  (excluding anhydrous milk fat), cocoa and chocolate products as covered by directive 2000/36/ec. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: A mixture of glycerol esters containing citric acid and fatty acids from food fats or oils. The specification does not establish a single animal or plant source for the fatty-acid component.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
